pinned_baseline.inspection: Read the ZIP central directory, info.json, and the two registered runtime modules only; compared the archive hash with the published-baseline record.

published_player_runtime_interfaces.name: more-infinite-research-browser

recognized_option_value_rules.search: string, truncated by the shipped source to 160 characters and directed by the selected tab
recognized_option_value_rules.tab: settings, research, queue, availability, or help; availability selected the research tab with visibility 3
recognized_option_value_rules.family: a string present in the target force's shipped catalogue
recognized_option_value_rules.selected: a string naming a technology in the target force
recognized_option_value_rules.hidden: accepted through the shipped hidden-set validator

open.result: boolean: whether the player browser root is open after rendering
open.side_effect: updates the target player's stored browser view and renders its GUI

current_mir5_source_bridge.status: Source and host-control bridge present; native registration, consumer compatibility, and transition qualification remain pending.
current_mir5_source_bridge.registration_source: source/mir5/runtime/bootstrap.lua:259-268 collision-checks and registers both historical names during control parse. It does not reproduce the MIR4 settings_profiles or research_library feature gates.

settings.implemented_shape: Non-table export options become {}; only compact == true selects compact export. Export uses effective current registered values, emits MIRSET1 through the current codec, and includes mir_version, factorio_version, and import_setting metadata. Validation is read-only and returns the historical valid/count/import_setting or invalid/error result shape.
settings.bounded_difference: The bridge exports only MIR5 registered settings and does not recreate the historical setting catalogue or apply a decoded profile.

implemented_legacy_option_fields.family: Accepted only as all or mir.
implemented_legacy_option_fields.sort: Accepted as progression, native, name-asc, or name-desc.
implemented_legacy_option_fields.selected: Accepted only after a bounded native-force technology lookup.
implemented_legacy_option_fields.page: Accepted as integral 1 through 30000 and retained as the continuous UI page.

browser.result: The bridge preserves the boolean open outcome. The old interface and the current bridge have no remote row/page response envelope; page-input equivalence is not established.

developer_sdk_and_mep.transition_position: These are developer-only historical preview shapes. They are neither a MIR5 emitted API nor accepted MIR5 import input, and this inventory does not authorise an adapter.
developer_sdk_and_mep.location: sdk/preview/mir4/ (excluded from the published player ZIP: no sdk/, preview/, or api/ members)

api_v1.compatibility: V1 may change before 1.0; V0 is an explicit read-only migration input and its emission is forbidden.

mep_v1.v0_status: Superseded compatibility input only; removal remains gated on accepted independent-consumer migration and an explicit later-release decision.

not_satisfied_by: MIR-owned tests, conformance material, fixtures, or synthetic preview extensions.

known_repository_references.query_scope: Exact-name text search of pinned source/ and tests/ only; generated outputs, package copies, and unrelated fixture trees were not treated as consumers.
known_repository_references.finding: The pinned checkout supplies self-tests, conformance material, and a synthetic reference extension. It contains no identified independent third-party runtime caller or independently shipped SDK/MEP consumer.

preserved_unaccepted_library_prior.difference: Its info.json declares base >= 2.1.18, so it is not the 708a published baseline.

package_dependency_rows.interpretation: Factorio dependency rows establish mod presence/version selection only. They do not enumerate remote-interface calls, SDK consumers, data-envelope fields, or external compatibility obligations.

external_unknowns_and_transition_obligat: No repository or archive inspection can identify mods outside this checkout that call either runtime interface.
No accepted independent SDK/MEP consumer migration record was found; the preview policy expressly keeps V0 removal gated on that evidence and a later release decision.
A MIR5 transition must audit real consumers against the named methods, option/response fields, registration gates, and preview data shapes before declaring compatibility, deprecation, or removal.
This record does not establish that the conditional runtime interfaces registered or worked in a Factorio process.
